name: First Crack
oneLiner: A small-batch coffee roastery that shows you the roast — every batch logged, every curve public, named for the moment the bean opens.
axisNote: second data-instrument exercise after Loopwell — warm CRAFT instrument (printed roast log, graph-paper grid, stamped ink) vs Loopwell's cool SaaS HUD; the vertical's real language is roast curves, first-crack timing, development ratios, cupping scores
paletteSeed: the roast's own gradient IS the palette: green-bean sage through gold and amber into roast brown on warm log-paper cream; charcoal ink; EMBER ORANGE reserved for one thing only — first crack; no kraft-bag brown-on-brown, no black-slate cafe chic
typeDirection: Young Serif (warm chunky display serif — the craft register, one weight used with confidence) + Hanken Grotesk (humanist text sans) + Space Mono (the instrument: log numerals, axis labels, letter-spaced micro-caps) — all OFL, vendored
motionBudget: one roast, scroll-driven: the curve draws from charge to drop as you scroll with a live time/temp/RoR readout, event flags plant themselves in order, and at 8:52 FIRST CRACK fires — the wordmark's C cracks (the one wink) and the ember accent enters the page; cupping bars fill on reveal; reduced-motion + no-JS = the complete annotated curve, all flags planted, readout at drop, cracked C already cracked

verdict.note: fix round closed ('looks a lot better now')
